scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('.next/server/prisma', { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('prisma/dev.db')) fs.copyFileSync('prisma/dev.db', '.next/server/prisma/dev.db'); console.log('[Build] Successfully bundled prisma/dev.db into .next/server/prisma/dev.db');"
